    Profile

    Ange is a young girl from a musical band called Mirage in the Desert Zone. She has the special power to heal people through dance. You can recognize her by her tanned skin. She looks younger than she is, maybe due to her physical build. In battle, she charms her opponents through her nimble dance art.

    Origin: Desert Zone
    Gender: Female
    Height: 155cm
    Weight: 40kg
    Birthday: May 1
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Thunderous Emperor
    Likes: Flower decorations
    Hobbies: Dance
    Illust: ―
    CV: 洲崎綾
